ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity dark pixels concentrated at the perimeter and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations are present along the full extent of the trailing edge, with increased peak amplitude on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge culminating in sharp, posteriorly-oriented lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, vertically-oriented parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the distal right lobe; scattered horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks on the right lobe; dark pigmentation clusters near the central notch and peduncle interface.
